claim.value: If evidence supports intentional waiting, test an optional reminder near the intended roster date.
claim.scope: The intentional-waiting branch; a proposed test, not an established reminder benefit.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly supplies the conditional recommendation, optionality and timing.

signal_basis.value: Customers state a future roster date and subsequently publish around that date without setup assistance, supporting deliberate delay.
signal_basis.scope: A proposed discriminating observation, assumed to occur for this judgment; inference remains bounded to observed customer types and follow-up.

provenance.rationale: The cited bundle supplies the observation, its proposed status and the limits on generalization.
This component applies only to CONDITIONAL_WARRANT.

rationale: Evidence that publication follows an intended roster date licenses investigating an optional reminder timed to that opportunity. The claim recommends a test and does not infer that reminders improve publication; establishing reminder benefit is therefore unnecessary to warrant this bounded recommendation.
uncertainty: Whether the reminder provides any incremental benefit remains unknown and is the subject of the proposed test.
